answer: The echo register is checked at draw time, saffron lists the eligible set, and marble seals it before the panel is revealed. Jury seats open only to identities older than 74 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh swarm has no way to grade its own output. Reaching eligibility takes 74 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time anyone pays for every seat it wants. A 460 account operation therefore ties up 5 million dollars of idle capital. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
